summary: Iteration 27 (Canvas-based match) frontend verification. All primary requirements PASS: (1) HomeScreen has no online-button; TournamentScreen play-matchday-button opens modal in prematch. (2) Prematch shows two lineup lists of 11 rows each, no mini-pitch, both start-match-button + prematch-cancel-button visible. (3) After start, canvas-match root appears with a <canvas> of non-zero size (710x426 CSS px); the old scoreboard + event-ticker testids are absent during playing/kickoff phases. (4) Integrated scoreboard present: canvas-stage ('GRUP AŞAMASI'), canvas-home-name, canvas-score, canvas-away-name, canvas-minute (with pulsating red dot span using 'bg-red-400 animate-pulse'), canvas-speed-picker with 4 canvas-speed-{slow|normal|fast|ultra} buttons; active button is highlighted amber. (5) Canvas rendering sanity: pixel sampled at (25%,50%) = rgb(14,112,~) which matches the turfDark colour (#0d5f2b). (6) Animation: toDataURL captured 600ms apart differ, confirming the RAF loop is continuously producing new frames. (7) Speed picker: clicking canvas-speed-ultra persists 'ultra' to localStorage['ucl_match_speed_v1']; match completes and close-match-button appears; potm-card renders with numeric rating. (8) Commentary log during play: observed 10 distinct entries within ~9s — 3 amber GOAL lines starting with minute prefix (e.g. "30' GOL! Michael Reiziger (TEST AJAX) 0-1", "32' GOL! Patrick Kluivert ... asist: Winston Bogarde", "46' GOL! Casemiro (2017 Real Madrid) 1-2 · asist: Isco"), 3 emerald SAVE lines ("20' Kaçan fırsat: ... — kaleci kurtardı"), 3 white SHOT lines ("11' Şut auta gitti — ..."), plus the initial 'Maç başladı...' placeholder. (9) Score prop bumps observed 3 times during play — each corresponds to an amber-coloured GOL line in the log. (10) Regression: prematch backdrop close still works (verified in iter-26 which we did not re-run); post-match POTM + close-match-button confirmed working here.

issues: Match runs to completion in ~9-10s even at SLOW speed. The AI dt multiplier for SLOW=1 is respected in the canvas AI simulation, but the parent MatchScreen ticker's speed.delay controls when engine events are revealed, and at SLOW that delay is short enough that the whole 90' timeline reveals in <10s. Filler commentary lines ('Pas.', 'Baskı.', 'Korner kullanılıyor.') therefore rarely surface — the filler emit gate needs ~3.5-6s of sim time between drops, so at SLOW only ~1-2 fillers fire before the match ends. Consider slowing the parent ticker further at SLOW, or lowering the filler gate to ~1.5-2.5s of sim time so more atmosphere lines appear.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Filler commentary throttle is a bit sparse at SLOW — either shorten filler interval in stepAI (sinceLastFiller > 3.5+rand()*2.5 → e.g. 1.5+rand()*1.5) or slow the parent MatchScreen ticker delay at SLOW so the sim time budget is larger.

(Optional/perf) The canvas 2d context is fetched without {willReadFrequently: true}, which triggers a browser warning when tests read pixels via getImageData. Not a real issue in production (no readbacks happen), but adding the flag silences the console warn.
critical_code_review_comments: CanvasMatch.tsx is ~720 lines and encapsulates renderer + AI + component nicely — good split. The RAF loop correctly reads speed via speedRef so the effect never restarts on prop changes; deps [homeFlashAt, awayFlashAt] restart on flash pulses which is intentional and cheap.

State ref initialization uses `if (stateRef.current === null)` inside the render — safe here because React never rehydrates a ref, but conventionally this is done in a useRef lazy initializer. Not a bug.

The commentary appendLog is called from inside the RAF loop for filler lines. This triggers a React setState on every ~4-6s of sim time, which is fine at any speed except potentially during hot-remount. No leaks observed in a full match run.

MatchScreen.jsx still has all the prematch/scoreboard/aggregate/POTM/next-leg glue in one file (~1000 lines). The old shot-anim/net-svg/ball-svg blocks are gone; ticker effect just advances visibleIdx by speed.delay. Recommend the same split-out suggestion from iter-26.

One minor UX gap: filler commentary is very sparse at slow/normal because the sim-time budget of the whole match is only ~9s at those speeds. Users may notice the log stays quiet between engine events. See action_items.

Pixel sampling on the canvas works — sampling at 25%/50% consistently returns turf green (r≈14, g≈112). For goal-flash verification, sample at CSS x in [W-26, W] (right goal) or [0, 26] (left goal), y around H/2, within ~700ms of the score prop bump. My earlier attempt sampled at 94%*W which lay ~17 CSS px outside the flash rectangle — remember flash rect starts at W-26 (device px, but ctx setTransform(dpr) makes CSS coords equivalent → 684..710 for a 710-wide canvas). The RAF loop is confirmed alive: toDataURL differs across 600ms.
